text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, someone crosses the finish 
line right before my eyes... ...I'm sick 
and tired of seeing it."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not running just to see a sight like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's to win, and to prove it... That I 
am... strong...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't cling to words like that. And 
yet—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The desire to win is certainly there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I'll be the one crossing the 
finish line in first.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: For that very reason, I will keep running.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You really know where it hurts...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are right. The only thing these eyes 
need to reflect is victory.
